message.content:
This is an LED driving light for motor vehicles, which falls under heading 8512 (electrical lighting or signaling equipment for motor vehicles). Subheading 8512.20 covers other lighting or visual signaling equipment. In the HTSUS, 8512.20.20 is for "Other lighting equipment," and 8512.20.40 is for "Other visual signaling equipment." In recent CBP rulings, LED auxiliary driving lights are classified in 8512.20.2040. The 8512.20.20 subheading splits as 8512.20.2020 (Lighting equipment: Parts of a kind used on... ) — I am not certain of the exact statistical suffixes. I recall that 8512.20.20 has the statistical suffixes 20 (Of the type used on motor vehicles... headlamps sealed beam?) and 40 (Other). Given that, 8512.20.2040 is the best estimate.

{"hts_code": "8512.20.2040", "reason": "Fixed LED auxiliary/driving lamps powered by a motor vehicle's electrical system are electrical lighting equipment for vehicles of heading 8512, falling under the 'other lighting equipment' subheading 8512.20.20, with the 'other' statistical suffix."}
